intro: You get the Pict-O-Matic from the «Lost and Found» mission. Select it with the D-pad and press [□] to see the scenes. To dress someone, pick them up and throw them into the tailor, hat shop or barbershop. Capsule codes turn green once you own them.
discs: Given by the «Lost and Found» mission (a cowboy in town): it is on a hill.
At the blacksmith, next to Slinky's farm.
On the hotel roof, in the new town (after blowing up the dam and building the hotel).
Next to the well in Zurg's Spaceport.
In the graveyard of Sid's Haunted House.
In the Enchanted Glen, at the end of the rope bridge.

missions.Pirate's Treasure: 3 townspeople with the pirate hat with eye patch {START} and pirate outfit {CP7}.
missions.Cactus Field Goal: Grab someone and kick them through the goalpost-shaped cactus. Facing town hall, go right down the street; it is on the left.
missions.Twins: 2 townspeople with Spikey Hair {CP6} and Gold Suit {CP47}.
missions.Scruffy Lady: 1 townsperson with Scruffy Lady Hair {CP10} and Scruffy Lady Outfit {CP20}.
missions.Viking Horde: 3 townspeople with Viking Hat {CP30}. Only the hat matters.
missions.Barber Shop Quartet: 4 barbers: barber cut with mustache {START} and barber outfit {START}. The original barber counts.
missions.Petting Zoo: Throw the farmer (white cowboy hat), a cow, a chicken and a pig into the lower corral of the farm.
missions.Jailhouse Jamboree: Put 5 bandits in jail. Usually happens on its own.
missions.Mariachi Band: 3 townspeople with sombrero {START} and mariachi outfit {START}.
missions.Alien Hero Team: 3 aliens with blue eye mask {START} and superhero outfit {START}. The original Super Alien counts.
missions.Disco Fest: 1 alien with Renegade Hair {CP94} and white lounge singer outfit {START}. Throw him into Slinky's barn.
missions.Clowning Around: 3 aliens with Clown Hat {CP232} and clown outfit {CP247}.
missions.Here Comes the Bride: 1 townsperson with Bride Hat {CP15} and Bride Outfit {CP55}.
missions.Intergalactic Law: 1 alien with Space Deputy Outfit {CP102} and Space Deputy Hat {CP85}; another with Indiana Jones hat {START} and sheriff outfit {START}.
missions.Hair Do from Outer Space: 1 alien with Spiked Hair {CP80}. Throw him into the barbershop.
missions.Space Ranger Trainee: 1 townsperson with Buzz helmet {START} and Space Ranger Outfit {CP91}.
missions.It's Huge: 1 alien with Pilot Hat {CP236} and Pilot Outfit {CP246}. Grow him with green goo.
missions.Cyborg Swordsman: 1 townsperson with Cyborg Outfit {CP89}. Throw him into the saloon.
missions.Lounge Lizards: 1 alien with the white lounge singer outfit {START} and another with Lounge Singer Outfit {CP90}. Both into the saloon.
missions.Create the Pirate Ghost: Townsperson with Pirate Outfit {CP7} and Pirate Hat {CP124}; bring a ghost from Sid's house and possess him. Then «X Marks the Spot»: dig with [□] by the animal bones on the hill, back left of the house.
missions.Deadly Squash: Possess someone at the farm, grow a pumpkin in the garden (moles), make it big with green goo, pull the ghost out with the lightning rod and shoot it at the pumpkin.
missions.Creature Chaos: Frankenstein {CP155} + {CP154}; vampire {CP141} + {CP128}; werewolf alien {CP132}; mummy alien {CP144}.
missions.Ghoul School: Witch {CP139} + {CP170}, skeleton {CP164} and zombie alien {CP145}. Throw them into the school. If it fails, give the witch green hair too.
missions.Zombie Horde: Zombie girl {CP138} + {CP140}, zombie boy {CP135} and zombie alien {CP145}.
missions.The Coven: 3 witches: Witch's hat {CP139} and Witch Outfit {CP170}.
missions.Party Zombie: 1 townsperson with Zombie Boy Outfit {CP135} and Milk Bottle Hat {CP2}.
missions.Take Us To Your Leader: 2 aliens with the pumpkin face outfit {SHOP}.
missions.Enchanted Town Hall: Paint the town hall with Lotso Walls {CP175}. Just in case, set a rainbow with the weather machine next to the pink pig.
missions.Giant Dragon Attack: Summon the dragon at the store, grow it with green goo and fly it to the middle of the rope bridge.
missions.Merlin: 1 townsperson with Merlin Hat {CP198} and Merlin Outfit {CP184}. He then gives you 2 missions.
missions.Berry Bonanza: 1 alien with Blueberries Hat {CP176} and Blueberries Outfit {CP181}; another with Strawberry Outfit {CP172}.
missions.Big Bad Wolf: 1 alien with Red Cape Outfit {CP174} and another with Werewolf Outfit {CP132}.

town: Start here after Hamm's tutorial. Some capsules only appear later, once more buildings are up.
farm: Includes the blacksmith and the mining area. You come back several times.
newtown: Opens with Hamm's «Blow up the Dam» mission.
zurg: One that is easy to miss: on the base mission, in the round control room, walk along the outer railing behind the cannon.
sid: Two that are easy to miss: after the first 3-lock door, in the hallway, grab the handle on the right wall past the first gap and push the wall; and in the stair room by the dining room, the floor switch opens a cabinet.
stunt: Requires buying the Stunt Park ($5,000). Drive in from the farm; the murals take you back up. The bowling game only appears with every story card.
candy: Throw balls at the button on top of the shop until only coins come out. If the button gets stuck, press another building's button and come back.

candy_hint: Candy shop: drops when you throw balls at the button on top of the shop.
